verses.text: Ha winh Satanás ix och ajk'olal t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yak' winh sk'ulej winhaj rey David yik syik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado israel winh smasanil.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yet' pax t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ixikek eyik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado. Sb'at he chakot t'a chonhab' Beerseba, masanto tzex k'och t'a chonhab' Dan. Ayik slajwi chi' tzeyik'ankot sb'isul heb' chi' t'ayin, yik swila' jantak heb' t'a smasanil.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --A'okab' Jehová tz'ak'an k'ib' sb'isul schonhab' masanto maxtzak yal sb'ischaji. Mamin rey ayoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab' smasanil, ¿tas yuj tza nib'ej jun tik? Ha t'a jun tik ol och smul ko chonhab' tik u'uj, xchi winh.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal winhaj Joab chi', yuj chi' ix b'at heb'. Ayik ix lajwi yik'ancha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' soldado Israel chi' heb', ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yak'an jantak sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado winhaj Joab t'a winhaj David chi', ay 470 mil heb' winh soldado yik Judá yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo smakb'en Israel ay jun millón yet' 100 mil heb' winh winak stiempo sb'at t'a owal.
Palta maj ochlaj heb' winh winak yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín sb'isulok, yujto maj scha sk'ol winhaj Joab jun scheknab'il winh rey chi'.
Maj schapaxlaj sk'ol jun chi' Dios, yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun yahelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.

Ichato chi' ix yalank'eta smul winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Te niwan in mul ix ochi, yujto ix in k'ulej jun tik, palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal jun in mul tik, yujto icha junok kistal anima ix wutej in b'a, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at il winhaj rey David, tzalan t'a winh to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ay oxe' tas swak' a sik'lej, a ach ol a sik'lej tas junok ol wak' t'ayach, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Gad chi' yil winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Sik'lej junok t'a skal juntzanh yahelal tik:

¿Tom ha' oxe' ab'il wejel, ma oxe' ujal ol yak' heb' ajk'ol ex smilanchamok, mato oxe' k'uhal ilya ol yak' t'a yol a makb'en tik? Ha jun chi' wespada a in Jehová in tik, yujto a jun wángel ol satanel anima t'a yol a makb'en tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' sik'lej tikne'ik yik wach' ol yal wak'an spak t'a Jehová, haton in chekankoti, xchi winhaj Gad chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Gad chi' icha tik: --Maxtzak nachajlaj wu'uj tas tzin sik'lej. Wach' hama to a Jehová tz'em sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, manhok anima swa sk'ab' t'ayin, yujto wojtak to niwan yok'elk'olal Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ilya Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', 70 mil heb' ix cham yuj.

Ix schekankot jun yángel Jehová yik satanel heb' anima t'a Jerusalén. Ayik wan satanel heb' anima chi', ix kusk'e sk'ol Jehová yuj jun yahelal chi', ix yalan t'a jun yángel wan smilancham anima chi' icha tik: Yechelxo chi', aktej, xchi t'ay. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', a jun yángel Jehová chi', ay wal ek' b'aj wan stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo.

Haxo ix k'e k'elan winhaj rey David, ix yilan winh to ayek' jun yángel Jehová chi' t'a snanhal lum lum tik yet' satcha'anh, yet'nakk'e jun k'e'en espada, wan yak'anem k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yib'anh Jerusalén. Yet'nhej chi' ix em nhojan winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel masanto t'a sat lu'um, ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Mamin, a in wal ix wala' to tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' chonhab' tik. Ha in wal ix och in mul. Malaj smul heb' anima tik. Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jun yahelal tik, ha t'a wib'anh yet' winhtilal tz'emi, manh a satel a chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Gad to syal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' to sb'ok'e junok altar winh b'aj stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' sb'ok'e jun altar yik tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'i Jehová, icha ix aj yalchaj chi'.
Ha winhaj Ornán yet' chanhwanh yuninal winh, wan stek'wi trigo heb', haxo ix yilan heb' to ayek' Yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix b'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ornán chi' to wan sk'och winh rey t'a slak'anil, ix elta winh b'aj wan stek'wi trigo chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tzok wal el t'a a k'o'ol, tza chonh jun lugar b'aj tzach tek'wi trigo tik t'ayin, yik tzin b'ok'e junok altar t'a Jehová, yik tz'och wa'an jun ilya tik t'a kal chonhab' tik. Chonh t'ayin icha wal jantak stojol, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Ornán chi' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, syal in si'an jun lugar tik t'ayach yik tza b'o'an tas snib'ej a k'o'ol. Swak'anpax nok' toro yik tz'och nok' silab'il yet' te' tek'lab' tik syal yoch te' t'a k'atzitzal, haxo ixim trigo tik, syal yoch ixim t'a ofrenda'il. Mamin rey, masanil juntzanh tik swak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach yuj masanil juntzanh tik, palta a in tik yowalil ol in tup juntzanh tik smasanil icha wal stojol, yujto max yal-laj wik'anek' a tastak, swak'an silab'il t'a Jehová. Max yal-laj wak'an junok tas silab'il to manh ol in tupu', xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smanan jun lu'um chi' winh rey chi' t'a 600 siclo k'e'en oro.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, ix snhusan silab' winh yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh jun silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a jun ángel chi' to syak'xi'em k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yol yatut.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj rey David to ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán chi', ix yak'an juntzanhxo silab' winh t'a Jehová ta'.
Wach'chom a jun mantiado sb'onakk'e winhaj Moisés yikok Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' ay t'a Gabaón jun lugar cha'anh yik ejmelal,
palta maj yal-laj sb'at winhaj rey David ta' yik sk'anb'ej t'a Dios, yujto ix te xiw winh ayik ix yilan jun k'e'en espada winh yet'nak Yángel Jehová.
